defects.source_says: One of those held files is the Federal Register correction at 34 FR 15443 (jobs/source-ladder/output/texts/queue_EO_10030_Executive_Order_11485_correction_34_FR_15443_PDF_page_5_7fb95ff9e4.txt), which states that the last sentence of Section 1 as printed at 34 FR 15411 is wrong and should read '...to aid the civil authorities of the District of Columbia.' reasoning: Sections 1 through 4 as continuing commands and section 5 as a supersession performed on issuance are reasonable readings, and no held instrument revokes or amends the order. But the section 5 first_end date is 1966-10-01, while the order is dated October 1, 1969 and the claim's own reasons say 1969-10-01; a wrong exact end date is disqualifying. Separately, the held FR correction at 34 FR 15443 corrects the last sentence of section 1; the claim quotes the misprinted text as operative and describes the correction file only as a queue file for EO 10030, so a held FR note about this order is left unaddressed and the search description is inaccurate.
